terminal_findings.mechanism: P0 did not fully enforce structural isolation from shared state or upstream completion; P1/P3 require post-irrevocable, value-copy, fresh-object, detached non-awaited execution with contained failures.
terminal_findings.precondition: The decorator shares mutable tags or exposes emitter completion upstream.
terminal_findings.event: Label decoration mutates shared state or the emitter blocks or throws.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Decision completion, latency, retries, or baseline telemetry changes.
terminal_findings.falsifier: G1 call-graph inspection and G2 failure-injection equivalence tests confirm one-way isolation and unchanged behavior.

terminal_findings.mechanism: The terminal proposal specifies isolation, but no implementation artifact demonstrates conformance.
terminal_findings.precondition: Implementation differs from the declared post-decision detached topology.
terminal_findings.event: Telemetry failure propagates through shared state, callbacks, awaiting, or exceptions.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Decision, status, retry count, completion behavior, or baseline metric output differs.
terminal_findings.falsifier: Passing G1 and G2 evidence for the actual implementation.

terminal_findings.mechanism: P2/P3 add baseline-capacity preservation, separate accounting, an independently reserved unlabeled diagnostic lane, and label-only rollback.
terminal_findings.precondition: Labeled and baseline telemetry share constrained resources.
terminal_findings.event: New label values increase series and queue load during peak traffic.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Baseline metrics are delayed, dropped, or evicted while diagnostics disappear.
terminal_findings.falsifier: The specified G4 controlled load test demonstrates unchanged baseline delivery and operable saturation signals.

terminal_findings.mechanism: Actual exporter, backend, and query headroom remains unverified despite the terminal capacity gates.
terminal_findings.precondition: Existing telemetry operates near a resource or quota limit.
terminal_findings.event: All allowlisted label values activate across existing dimensions.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Queue drops, memory pressure, quota exhaustion, query degradation, dashboard gaps, or alert churn.
terminal_findings.falsifier: G4 peak-load and cardinality evidence proves reserved capacity or sufficient measured headroom.

terminal_findings.mechanism: P3 replaces field-ingestion compatibility with blocking consumer-output equivalence across matching, grouping, joins, alerts, dashboards, exports, and validators.
terminal_findings.precondition: A consumer assumes the prior label set or single-series identity.
terminal_findings.event: The additive label splits series identity.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Missing or many-to-many joins, duplicate or absent alerts, or dashboard fan-out.
terminal_findings.falsifier: The specified G5 inventory and enum-plus-unknown golden replay preserves all consumer-visible outputs.

terminal_findings.mechanism: No consumer inventory or golden replay results were supplied.
terminal_findings.precondition: An existing rule, dashboard, export, or validator depends on exact labels or implicit matching.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Consumer results diverge despite unchanged decision behavior.
terminal_findings.falsifier: Passing G5 evidence for every affected consumer and label value.

terminal_findings.mechanism: The exact label key, enum, unknown semantics, designated metrics, and deterministic derivation mapping remain unspecified.
terminal_findings.precondition: Implementation selects ambiguous or inconsistent label semantics.
terminal_findings.event: Equivalent decisions receive inconsistent labels or unknown values are misinterpreted.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Audit output is misleading and fails the intended visibility purpose.
terminal_findings.falsifier: G3 freezes and validates the complete label contract and mapping.

terminal_findings.mechanism: No evidence proves metric descriptors are excluded from schema-hash inputs.
terminal_findings.precondition: Schema hashing includes metric descriptors or label keysets.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: The schema hash changes, violating the unchanged-schema invariant.
terminal_findings.falsifier: G6 demonstrates descriptor exclusion and an unchanged resulting schema hash.

limitations: Closed-world case supplied no implementation, consumer, capacity, or schema-hash artifacts.
Isolation claims are limited to observable fresh-thread and separately-instructed setup; they do not claim cognitive independence.
No specialists were used, as required. The Chief received one complete-record handoff only after three closed rounds.
